query: which papers report the results of the project that set out to resolve the allelic phase of tertiary EGFR substitutions at progression and to advance allosteric compounds active against triple-mutant receptors
notes: P01 is a direct product of G01: it phases C797S in 188 progression specimens and reports the allosteric compound DFC-114 at 18 nM against the cis triple mutant, exactly Aims 1-2 of the grant. P13 is the second G01-funded paper (paired tissue/plasma at second-line progression). P19 (cereblon degrader eliminating EGFR triple mutants) addresses the same untreatable allele from a different grant, hence 2. P09 (amivantamab for exon 20 insertions) is a different allele class with no tertiary substitution and no phasing, so explicitly 0.

query: papers produced by the grant that proposed to establish when RB1 and TP53 are lost relative to the appearance of neuroendocrine markers and to interrupt the switch pharmacologically
notes: P07 delivers Aim 1 of G04 (388 patients; biallelic RB1+TP53 at baseline gives 19.4 vs 0.7 percent three-year conversion, median 17.8 months to conversion) and P08 delivers Aims 2-3 (Sftpc-traced EgfrL858R;Rb1fl;Trp53fl mice, H3K27me3 loss across a 340-enhancer ASCL1 domain, LSD1 inhibition lowering conversion to 9 percent). P06 detects the ASCL1/INSM1/DLL3 program in 6 of 32 human residual-disease specimens, so 2. P11 (lorlatinib vs crizotinib) contains no lineage-switch content and is explicitly 0.

query: results from the program that proposed multiplex TRAC and B2M disruption plus a non-classical inhibitory ligand knock-in so that a banked donor-derived product survives host clearance
notes: P09 is the first-in-human report of the G05 platform (TRAC 92 percent and B2M 88 percent editing, no grade 2+ GVHD, transgene gone by day 60 in 22 of 26) and P10 is the HLA-E single-chain trimer knock-in at the disrupted B2M locus that answers exactly the clearance failure P09 identified. P02 is an autologous bivalent CD19/CD22 product with no editing and no allogeneic component, so explicitly 0.

query: publications arising from the project on whether integrity of tumor cytokine sensing determines durable benefit from PD-1 blockade
notes: All three of P01, P02 and P03 list GRANT:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G01 in funded_by. P01 is the closest to the grant's central hypothesis: JAK1/JAK2 loss in 11 of 96 progression specimens with failure to upregulate class I or secrete CXCL9, and duplex detection of the same variant at 0.4-1.6 percent in matched baselines, which is Aim 1's subclone question answered. P16 (CD73/adenosine) is metabolic restraint from a different grant and is explicitly 0.

query: papers funded by the cooperative agreement that proposed an absolute HER2 protein scale by mass spectrometry, internalization and trafficking rates, and a measured bystander effect for conjugate payload delivery
notes: P09, P10 and P13 all carry GRANT:BREAST_CDK_G04 in funded_by. P13 is the most direct realization of the grant's trafficking and delivery aims: surface HER2 falling from 18,400 to 4,900 receptors per cell without ERBB2 loss, and SLC46A3 knockout reproducing a 68 percent drop in payload accumulation. P22 (neoadjuvant trastuzumab plus pertuzumab in amplified disease) states its results should not be extrapolated to the non-amplified setting, so it is explicitly 0.

query: which publications came out of the program that proposed to run a standardized ten-color phenotypic panel and immunoglobulin clonotype sequencing on the same residual disease specimens and to test trial-level surrogacy
notes: P11 executes Aims 1-2 of G06 (612 paired specimens, kappa 0.79, latent class sensitivity 0.93 vs 0.71 in the 0.001-0.01 percent range, hemodilution explaining 41 percent of discordance) and P12 executes Aim 3 (14 randomized trials, trial-level R-squared 0.72). P19 is the same assay validated across 11 laboratories but is unfunded, hence 2. LUNG_EGFR_P22 measures postoperative residual disease in plasma for a solid tumor and shares no assay or funding link, so explicitly 0.

query: trial reports generated by the coordinated preoperative program that proposed serial fine-needle aspirates, patient-specific plasma panels, and an attenuated CTLA-4 dose
notes: P12 is the melanoma arm of G06 run under the grant's own NCT04205552 with ipilimumab at 1 mg/kg, reporting 10 percent or less residual viable tumor in 58.6 percent and 96 vs 41 percent two-year recurrence-free survival; P13 is the lung arm delivering the day-21 plasma clearance aim (AUC 0.87). G10 is credited as a co-funder of P12 hence 1. BREAST_CDK_P22 is neoadjuvant but HER2-directed chemotherapy de-escalation with no checkpoint agent, so explicitly 0.

query: papers reporting work from the award that mandated biopsy at progression and plasma every eight weeks in order to separate alterations selected under CDK4/6 inhibitor pressure from those present all along
notes: P01, P03 and P04 all list GRANT:BREAST_CDK_G01 in funded_by. P04 is the clearest execution of the grant's Aim 2: 1,020 plasma samples drawn every 8 weeks from 195 patients, acquired RB1 in 5.6 percent and CCNE1 gain in 16.4 percent, with tumor DNA burden rising a median 9.6 weeks before radiographic progression. P18 (population pharmacokinetics of palbociclib) explicitly states it speaks to dose selection rather than mechanisms of escape and is unfunded, so 0.

query: A preclinical comparison of endodomain architecture established that receptors carrying 4-1BB support a longer functional lifespan and a less differentiated effector pool than CD28-containing receptors, which is why 4-1BB constructs dominate in leukemia.
notes: This is the citing sentence from the Introduction of PAPER:HEME_CART_P01, and the reference it carries is PAPER:HEME_CART_P15, the 16-member graded receptor series showing that area under the phospho-CD3 zeta curve, not endodomain identity, predicts loss of the CD45RA+CCR7+ fraction (R-squared 0.81) and that endodomain identity adds nothing once amplitude is in the model. P09 uses a 4-1BB construct but studies allogeneic editing rather than endodomain design, so explicitly 0.

query: Phasing work has shown that allelic configuration determines whether inhibitor pairs retain activity, and that the untreatable configuration predominates in previously treated patients.
notes: This is the citing sentence from the Introduction of PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P19; the cited work is PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P01, which phased C797S in 41 of 44 carriers, found cis in 26 of 31 phased second-line cases, and showed the trans configuration responding to a first- plus third-generation pair (4 of 7) while none of 11 cis cases responded to any pocket-directed regimen. P10 is a structure-guided inhibitor for exon 20 insertions with no phasing content, so explicitly 0.

query: Serial plasma sequencing in patients progressing on palbociclib with fulvestrant showed that CCNE1 copy gain emerges during treatment in roughly one in six patients and is associated with a shorter time to progression, while acquired RB1 events occur in fewer than 6 percent.
notes: This is the citing sentence from the Introduction of PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P05; the cited work is PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P04, which is the only document reporting exactly these two numbers from serial plasma under palbociclib plus fulvestrant (CCNE1 gain in 16.4 percent with hazard ratio 1.87 for shorter time to progression, acquired RB1 in 5.6 percent). P06 is also dense serial plasma sequencing but tracks ESR1 allele fractions during fulvestrant and reports neither CCNE1 nor RB1, so it is a tempting near-miss judged 0.

query: Prior work in melanoma showed that inactivation of the tumor cytokine response module can be selected at late progression from subclones detectable before treatment at fractions below two percent, which raises the question of whether display defects follow the same acquired trajectory or are instead present from the outset.
notes: This is the citing sentence from the Introduction of PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P02; the cited work is PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P01, which reports JAK1/JAK2 loss in 11 of 96 progression specimens after a median 19.4 months of response and duplex detection of the identical variant at 0.4 to 1.6 percent allele fraction in 4 matched baselines, matching the sentence's 'below two percent' claim precisely. P02 is the citing paper itself and is genuinely on topic (biallelic B2M) hence 2. P20 is nivolumab population pharmacokinetics and is explicitly 0.

query: Organized lymphoid aggregates with germinal centers have attracted attention chiefly in the context of immunotherapy, where a graded assessment in head and neck cancer showed that only structures containing active germinal centers were associated with survival after PD-1 blockade, while immature structures behaved like their absence.
notes: This is the citing sentence from the Introduction of PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P23; the cited work is PAPER:IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P07, the only head and neck study applying a CD21/CD23/Ki-67/AICDA maturation grade to 312 pre-treatment specimens and finding 24.6 vs 9.8 vs 8.9 month survival with no difference between early structures and their absence. P22 is spatial margin profiling but of TREM2 macrophages rather than lymphoid structures, so explicitly 0.

query: A post-progression genotyping series is informative here: among patients whose disease progressed only in the neuraxis, kinase-domain substitutions were largely absent, implying that failure in that compartment reflects inadequate concentration rather than acquired insensitivity.
notes: This is the citing sentence from the Introduction of PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P16; the cited work is PAPER:LUNG_EGFR_P12, which genotyped 232 post-progression ALK specimens and reported that progression restricted to intracranial sites occurred in 95 patients of whom only 21 carried any kinase-domain substitution. BREAST_CDK_P15 is unbound CNS pharmacology but in breast cancer with no kinase-domain genotyping of intracranial-only progression, so it is a near-miss judged 0.

query: Work in patient-derived xenografts and organoids established that palbociclib drives most cells into a persistent senescent state with an interleukin 6 and CXCL8 secretory program whose survival depends on BCL-xL, and that clearing that population with a selective senolytic roughly doubles the time to regrowth.
notes: This is the citing sentence from the Introduction of PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P16; the cited work is PAPER:BREAST_CDK_P07, which reports 58-74 percent senescent fraction persisting past day 60, a CRISPR screen in 14-day-arrested cells returning BCL2L1 at log fold change -3.2, and A-1331852 extending median time to regrowth from 34 to 71 days. HEME_CART_P04 concerns an epigenetically fixed dysfunctional state in T cells rather than senescent tumor cells and is explicitly 0.

query: reversible non-genetic states that let a small population survive continuous drug and later seed regrowth, described both in oncogene-driven lung adenocarcinoma and in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer
notes: Answering this requires joining two subdomains through a shared concept rather than a shared string. LUNG_EGFR_P05 is the clearest lung-side instance: surviving cells acquire no kinase-domain variant above 0.5 percent, revert to parental IC50 within 21 days of withdrawal, and depend on GPX4. BREAST_CDK_P16 is the breast-side counterpart: an AP-1-high, MKI67-low state expanding from 4.2 to 21.7 percent that is distributed across clonal lineages rather than confined to one. BREAST_CDK_P04 documents acquired genetic RB1 and CCNE1 lesions, the opposite of a reversible state, so it is judged 0.

query: escape by loss or downmodulation of the very surface molecule the therapy is addressed to, compared across CD19-directed cell therapy, BCMA and GPRC5D engagers, and HER2-directed conjugates
notes: The link is a concept shared across two subdomain files. HEME_CART_P01 gives the leukemia instance (22 of 41 relapses target negative, exon 2 skipping in 14, biallelic truncating events in 9); BREAST_CDK_P13 gives the solid-tumor conjugate instance in a different file (surface HER2 falling 18,400 to 4,900 per cell without ERBB2 loss, reversible after 8 weeks off drug, driven by selection of a pre-existing 3.1 percent low-expressing subpopulation). IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P02 is B2M loss, which disables presentation rather than removing a therapeutic target, and is judged 0.

query: how much unbound drug actually reaches intracranial disease and why structurally similar agents differ, drawing on measurements made in lung cancer and in breast cancer
notes: Requires combining the two subdomains that measured the same quantity. LUNG_EGFR_P16 reports unbound partitioning for nine agents under identical conditions (0.53 lorlatinib to 0.02 ceritinib), shows total-drug ratios misrank five of nine, and attributes most variance to Abcb1/Abcg2. BREAST_CDK_P15 is the breast counterpart with an unbound CSF-to-plasma ratio of 0.96 for abemaciclib versus 0.09 palbociclib and 0.04 ribociclib, and knockout mice confirming weak transporter substrate status. BREAST_CDK_P18 is population pharmacokinetics with no CNS compartment and is explicitly 0.

query: where in the pathway from diagnosis to receipt of an effective therapy patients are lost, and how that loss differs by race, insurance and distance, taken across lung cancer, lymphoma and breast cancer
notes: Three subdomain files must be joined to answer this. HEME_CART_P17 supplies the cellular-therapy funnel (41 percent referred, 27 percent collected, 22 percent infused; referral odds 0.62 for Medicaid and 0.71 for Black patients, disparities vanishing after referral), LUNG_EGFR_P20 the profiling cascade (62 percent profiled, 78 percent of actionable results treated, adjusted odds 0.71 Black vs White), and BREAST_CDK_P21 the dispensing step (median possession ratio 0.79, 19-day prescription-to-dispense). IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P21 is a payer cost-effectiveness model with no access or equity measurement and is judged 0.

query: removing the target protein rather than occupying its binding site as a way past mutations that defeat occupancy-based agents, in both kinase-driven lung cancer and endocrine-resistant breast cancer
notes: The concept spans two subdomain files. LUNG_EGFR_P19 shows WLT-233 giving 94 percent protein loss at DC50 14 nM against the L858R/T790M/C797S triple mutant with growth inhibition of 22 vs 19 nM for cis and trans configurations, collapsing an 80-fold difference seen with inhibitor pairs; BREAST_CDK_P17 is the breast counterpart with vepdegestrant degrading wild-type and mutant ER at 1.8-4.6 nM versus 44-61 percent maximal removal for fulvestrant. LUNG_EGFR_P10 is a pocket-directed inhibitor that the degrader paper calls complementary rather than equivalent, so it is judged 0.

query: engineered T-cell therapy directed at solid tumors, NOT studies confined to B-cell or myeloid blood cancers
notes: HEME_CART_P13 is the top-graded document because it is entirely inside the scope: mesothelin-directed cells with a dominant-negative TGFBR2 in orthotopic KPC pancreatic implants, 184 vs 41 cells per square millimeter at day 7 and median survival 31 to 58 days. The explicit zeros are the trap: P02 (CD19/CD22 in B-ALL), P09 and P10 (CD19 in B-cell malignancy), P20 (CD33 in AML) and P01 (CD19 relapse) are all CAR engineering papers that satisfy the first half of the query and violate the solid-tumor restriction; LUNG_EGFR_P18 satisfies the solid-tumor half but involves no engineered cell product.

query: resistance to CDK4/6 inhibition in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer acting through the cell cycle or PI3K axis, NOT resistance operating through the estrogen receptor itself such as ESR1 mutation or failure of receptor-degrading endocrine agents
notes: BREAST_CDK_P05 is the cleanest in-scope answer: low-molecular-weight cyclin E1 sustains RB1 serine 807 phosphorylation at 74 percent of baseline under palbociclib, CDK2 inhibition drops it to 12 percent and gives 71 percent growth inhibition across six cyclin E1-high xenografts, with no estrogen-receptor mechanism involved. The six zeros are documents about the same disease and often the same patients that satisfy 'endocrine resistance after CDK4/6 exposure' but violate the exclusion because their mechanism is ESR1 helix-12 mutation or receptor degradation (P02, P06, P12, P17, G02, G12).

query: failure of checkpoint blockade caused by the tumor cell's own inability to display antigen or to sense interferon, NOT failure imposed by suppressive myeloid cells or by the metabolic microenvironment
notes: IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P02 is exemplary in-scope: biallelic B2M inactivation in 38 of 412 patients, absent surface light chain in 34, response 2.6 vs 31.8 percent despite equivalent PD-L1 score and equivalent variant counts, and the defect clonal before therapy. LUNG_EGFR_P18 earns 2 from a different subdomain file because restoring class I by STAT1 activation conferred sensitivity to PD-1 blockade. The zeros (P04, P05, P16, G02, G09, P17) are all checkpoint-failure documents whose mechanism is myeloid, metabolic or commensal rather than tumor-intrinsic display or sensing.

query: neurologic toxicity after infusion of engineered T cells, its mechanism and prevention, NOT prolonged cytopenia, infection or second cancers
notes: HEME_CART_P07 is the mechanism paper: interleukin 1 beta inflects a median 22 hours before the first neurologic sign and 14 hours before the interleukin 6 peak, mediation attributes 61 percent to the angiopoietin shift, and tocilizumab abolishes fever without shortening events. The zeros are the other post-infusion complications from the same subdomain, all of which would score highly on a naive 'CAR T toxicity' match: P21 cytopenia, P18 infection density, P22 second malignancy, plus their grants G12 and G10.

query: immune features of resected tumors that carry prognostic weight in patients who never received checkpoint inhibitors, NOT cohorts treated with PD-1 or CTLA-4 blockade
notes: IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P22 satisfies both halves exactly: 214 hepatocellular resections in which 'no patient received immunotherapy before or after surgery', with upper-tertile marginal TREM2-high density giving 61 vs 29 percent two-year recurrence and adjusted hazard ratio 2.1. P23 is the second in-scope document (286 colorectal liver metastases, checkpoint-treated patients excluded by design). The zeros are the corresponding treated-cohort studies of the identical tissue features, P06 and P07 for lymphoid aggregates and P04 and P05 for TREM2 macrophages, which is precisely the distinction the query asks a system to make.

query: progression on osimertinib driven by a second receptor tyrosine kinase, NOT by a further substitution within EGFR itself
notes: LUNG_EGFR_P03 is squarely in scope: 118 patients with centrally confirmed high-level MET copy gain treated with savolitinib plus osimertinib, 49 percent confirmed response rising to 62 percent above a ratio of 5, and second-progression escape through MET kinase-domain substitutions D1228N and Y1230C. The zeros are the on-target counterparts a lexical or embedding match would happily return: P01 and G01 (C797S allelic phase), P19 (degrader for EGFR triple mutants) and P10 (exon 20 insertion-selective inhibitor).

query: assay measurement-property studies that deliberately report no patient outcome data, NOT analyses that tie the assay to response or survival
notes: IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P18 states outright that 'No clinical outcome data were used' and reports only variance partitioning across four PD-L1 assays, three laboratories and 28 pathologists (reader variance 9 percent for tumor cells but 46 percent for immune cells). P19 similarly states 'No patient outcomes were analyzed', HEME_CART_P19 is pure multisite analytical validation, and LUNG_EGFR_P04 explicitly declines to address which threshold predicts benefit. The zeros are assay papers that do report outcomes: P08 (PD-L1 plus TMB predicting response), HEME_CART_P11 (concordance plus 5-year event-free survival), BREAST_CDK_P09 (reproducibility plus recurrence-free survival), IMMUNO_P09 (assay agreement plus response).

query: resistance to T-cell-engaging bispecific antibodies in multiple myeloma, target loss versus effector dysfunction, NOT CAR T-cell products and NOT antibody-drug conjugates aimed at the same antigen
notes: HEME_CART_P05 is the top-graded document because it partitions teclistamab failure exactly as the query asks: 11 of 52 progressions with biallelic TNFRSF17 events, 9 more with shed receptor above 400 ng/mL, and 32 with the target intact where CD8 cells carrying three or more coinhibitory receptors rose from 12 to 41 percent. HEME_CART_P23 is the sharpest near-miss and is judged 0 because belantamab mafodotin hits the same BCMA target but is a conjugate whose failure biology has, in its own words, no counterpart in effector dysfunction; P02, P09 and P01 are CAR products, and LUNG_EGFR_P09 is a bispecific antibody that is not a T-cell engager.

query: evidence that CDK4/6 inhibition acts through the adaptive immune system, restricted to systems that actually have one, NOT conclusions drawn only from immunodeficient xenograft hosts
notes: BREAST_CDK_P08 satisfies both constraints: three estrogen receptor-positive syngeneic lines in immunocompetent hosts, 3.4-fold higher surface class I, effector-to-regulatory ratio rising 2.1 to 7.8, 62 vs 8 percent complete regression with anti-PD-1, and CD8 depletion collapsing benefit to 4 percent. The zeros are the near-misses on each axis: P07, P05 and P17 are CDK4/6 immune-adjacent but run in NSG xenografts (P07 states outright that its host lacks an adaptive immune system), P03 is cell lines and xenografts with no immune readout, and LUNG_EGFR_P18 is immunocompetent but has nothing to do with CDK4/6 inhibition.

query: clonal hematopoiesis and therapy-related second cancers after cellular therapy, NOT the antitumor efficacy of the product
notes: HEME_CART_P22 is the top-graded document: 1932 patients, 7 T-cell neoplasms, 4-year cumulative incidence 0.42 percent with standardized incidence ratio 1.6, transgene absent from 4 of 7 tumors and no tumor clonotype matching a dominant product clone, with 6 of 7 carrying pre-infusion clonal hematopoiesis. P21 is the companion cytopenia and clonal hematopoiesis analysis. The zeros are the efficacy-oriented documents from the same subdomain that a topic match would surface: P16 (registry effectiveness), P08 (anakinra with response and PFS), P03 (product composition and durable remission) and their grants.

query: preoperative systemic therapy assessed by residual viable tumor in the resection specimen, restricted to checkpoint blockade, NOT HER2-directed chemotherapy de-escalation and NOT post-operative adjuvant designs
notes: IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P12 satisfies every clause: two preoperative cycles of nivolumab with low-dose ipilimumab, 10 percent or less residual viable tumor in 34 of 58 resection specimens, and 96 vs 41 percent two-year recurrence-free survival by that threshold. The zeros are the deliberate near-misses: BREAST_CDK_P22 is neoadjuvant with a pathologic complete response endpoint but the systemic therapy is trastuzumab, pertuzumab and chemotherapy; LUNG_EGFR_P22, BREAST_CDK_P14 and GRANT:BREAST_CDK_G09 are adjuvant designs with disease-free survival endpoints and no resection-specimen readout of treatment effect.

query: blood-based detection of molecular escape or residual disease ahead of imaging in solid tumors, NOT marrow-based measurable residual disease assays in blood cancers
notes: BREAST_CDK_P06 is the tightest fit: a prespecified twofold rise in mutant allele fraction on two consecutive draws preceded radiographic progression by a median 11.4 weeks with sensitivity 0.78 and specificity 0.84, which is exactly 'ahead of imaging'. BREAST_CDK_P04 gives the 9.6-week lead time and LUNG_EGFR_P22 the postoperative molecular residual disease substudy with hazard ratio 5.4. The four zeros are the strongest lexical competitors in the corpus for 'measurable residual disease' and all violate the solid-tumor restriction, being marrow aspirate assays in leukemia and myeloma.

query: determinants of benefit from checkpoint blockade that lie outside the tumor genome, in the host or the environment, NOT tumor-intrinsic genomic biomarkers
notes: IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P17 is the clearest host-side determinant: prospectively banked stool from 512 patients, antibiotic exposure within 30 days giving a weighted hazard ratio of 1.61 and response 22 vs 38 percent, with germ-free transfer from responders and non-responders reproducing the phenotype. The zeros are the tumor-genomic biomarkers that dominate this subdomain and would be retrieved by any 'predictors of checkpoint blockade benefit' matcher: B2M loss, HLA haplotype loss, TMB estimation, PD-L1 plus TMB, and JAK pathway loss.

query: solid-tumor barriers to T-cell entry and function addressed by modifying the transferred cell itself, NOT by systemically administered antibodies or small molecules
notes: HEME_CART_P14 is the top-graded document because the intervention lives entirely in the transferred cell: CXCR2 transduction plus a hypoxia-responsive IL-12 cassette raising intratumoral density from 58 to 212 cells per square millimeter, with intravital imaging localizing the gain to extravasation and no detectable systemic IL-12. The zeros satisfy 'solid-tumor barrier to T-cell function' but through a systemically delivered agent instead: anti-TREM2 depletion (P04), A2A antagonism and anti-VEGFR2 (P16, G09), and adenoviral STAT1 with anti-PD-1 (LUNG_EGFR_P18).

query: studies with a concurrent randomized control arm, NOT single-arm cohorts and NOT dose-escalation studies
notes: LUNG_EGFR_P11 is representative of the in-scope set: 296 previously untreated patients assigned 1:1 to lorlatinib or crizotinib with blinded independent review and hazard ratio 0.28, an unambiguous concurrent control. All eight grade-3 documents state explicit randomization and allocation ratios. The nine zeros are prospective interventional trials that a 'clinical trial' matcher would return but that have no control arm: phase 1 dose escalations (HEME_CART_P02, P09), single-arm phase 2 studies (HEME_CART_P08, BREAST_CDK_P11, P19, LUNG_EGFR_P03, P09) and single-arm preoperative cohorts (IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P12, P13). HEME_CART_P12 is a meta-analysis of 14 randomized trials rather than a trial itself, hence 2.

query: grant applications whose aims embed a randomized clinical trial inside the mechanistic program, NOT proposals whose only clinical component is a single-arm or dose-escalation study and NOT purely preclinical proposals
notes: GRANT:BREAST_CDK_G09 is a clean in-scope example: Aim 1 randomizes 2,400 women to two versus four years of adjuvant abemaciclib and Aim 3 performs a second randomization to prophylactic loperamide, both nested in the same mechanistic circulating tumor DNA program. Each grade-3 grant names a randomized allocation in its aims. The zeros are the discriminating cases: HEME_CART_G01 and G04 do embed interventional trials but they are a 3+3 dose escalation and a single-arm Simon two-stage study respectively, while LUNG_EGFR_G01, BREAST_CDK_G03, IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_G02 and LUNG_EGFR_G06 have no interventional clinical component at all.

query: reports of an antibody carrying a cytotoxic payload, NOT naked antibodies, bispecific antibodies or T-cell engagers
notes: BREAST_CDK_P13 is the strongest in-scope document because every mechanism it dissects is payload-specific: SLC46A3 loss cutting intracellular payload accumulation 71 percent without changing binding or internalization, plus ABCC2 upregulation as a third route. The five zeros are all antibody therapeutics that fail the payload clause: amivantamab and its supportive-care study (LUNG_EGFR_P09, P23) are a bispecific, teclistamab and talquetamab (HEME_CART_P05, P06) are T-cell engagers, trastuzumab plus pertuzumab (BREAST_CDK_P22) are naked, and anti-TREM2 (IMMUNO_CHECKPOINT_P04) is a depleting antibody whose activity requires an intact Fc rather than a payload.

query: central nervous system spread and intracranial drug activity in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer, NOT lung cancer CNS pharmacology
notes: BREAST_CDK_P15 is the top-graded document: paired plasma, cerebrospinal fluid and resected lesions from 43 breast cancer patients giving an unbound CSF-to-plasma ratio of 0.96 for abemaciclib against 0.09 for palbociclib and 0.04 for ribociclib, with intracranial response in only 3 of 58 despite adequate exposure. The zeros are the lung-cancer CNS documents that share almost all of the query's vocabulary (unbound partitioning, efflux transporters, intracranial progression) and violate the disease restriction; MULT0018 deliberately asks the cross-disease version of the same question so that scope discrimination can be measured against it.
